notes.title: Update! Collections, Achievements and New Levels
notes.content:
Hello, in this update, we’ve implemented significant changes and improvements.

After receiving several improvement suggestions from you, we decided to return to work on Mimi the Cat – Meow Together to provide a better experience. This update includes:

[b]15 New Levels[/b] – All handcrafted with care, ensuring challenges and fun! We also organized the level progression to make the evolution smoother and more satisfying.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44531175/a7e1086af1762cd2aee48e56696047f76f1471f2.gif[/img]

[b]Steam Achievements[/b] – Now you can unlock achievements as you progress in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44531175/329a7da9056f0d9acc86bf67c4483035de17c516.png[/img]

[b]New Outfits![/b] – Mimi and her friends are ready to show off their style! We added 5 new customization options, allowing you to create the perfect combination!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44531175/ca488a40fb647bef74f903cef0d218d212c9ac4d.gif[/img]

[b]Critical bugs[/b] related to the trains have been fixed. If you encounter any issues, please report them in our Community Hub.

Follow our developer page on Steam to stay updated!
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/WiseBoxStudios]Wise Box Studios[/url]

notes.title: Update: Achievements and New Outfits Coming Soon!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44531175/59f620b70ffd4c69627b99d0a2372df97fbd8e5c.png[/img]

Hello everyone!

We want to let you know that we are currently working on implementing achievements for Mimi the Cat - Meow Together. Although the achievements are visible on the store page, they are not yet available in the game at the moment. We are dedicated to ensuring everything works perfectly before releasing them to you.

Additionally, we are working on new outfits for Mimi! A general update is on the way to bring these new features to the game.

We appreciate your patience and support as we continue to improve the game. Stay tuned for more updates soon!

Thank you!
